title: Add The Hollow Beneath Emberfall module smoke path
description:
Add a smoke path proving that Eshyra can create a campaign from a campaign template (the Emberfall setting), attach the starter module (The Hollow Beneath Emberfall) via a campaign-owned adventure run / module binding, run or simulate initial module progress, persist state, and resume with correct module progress.

This should be the adventure-module equivalent of a hello-world gameplay path.
design:
This does not need a full live model integration test if that would be brittle. A deterministic or semi-deterministic runtime/context-builder smoke path is enough for the first pass.

The important proof is that immutable module source content, campaign instance state (the campaign-owned adventure run / module binding and its progress), runtime context, and persistence all connect cleanly - and that progress updates never mutate the module source.
acceptance_criteria:
- A test, fixture, or scripted smoke path creates a campaign using the Emberfall campaign template and attaches The Hollow Beneath Emberfall starter module via a campaign-owned adventure run / module binding.
- The smoke path starts the module and records initial progress.
- The smoke path advances at least one location or scene.
- The smoke path reveals or preserves at least one secret correctly.
- The smoke path records an objective or encounter state change.
- The smoke path saves and reloads the campaign.
- After reload, the active adventure run / module binding and module progress are intact.
- The authored source module remains unchanged after progress updates.
notes: Smoke at packages/core/test/hollowBeneathEmberfallSmoke.test.ts; PR #270 open (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/270). Proves create->bind->progress->runtime-context->persist->reload + source-unchanged. rulesRef/SRD-key reconciliation split out to eshyra-8bit.
close_reason: Merged via PR #270. Deterministic smoke proves create->bind->progress->runtime-context->persist->reload with source unchanged. rulesRef/SRD reconciliation tracked as eshyra-8bit.
